dialogues.speaker: Chambelland
dialogues.text: Um... Ahem! I'd say the future of those working in Lumidouce Harbor isn't very bright. It's practically a black hole for career progression, and the pay is lousy. It's better to strike out on your own.

dialogues.speaker: Chambelland
dialogues.text: Boss, if you hire me, I... I could help you make some connections. I know—

dialogues.speaker: Chambelland
dialogues.text: Wait a minute, you're...! Oh my goodness! It's an honor to see you here. I've heard Mr. Chaussivert talk about you. You're truly exceptional!

dialogues.speaker: Chambelland
dialogues.text: If you decide to hire me for the job, I'll give you a... let's say, 20% discount!

dialogues.speaker: Chambelland
dialogues.text: Why don't you think it over? If you ever decide to hire me, you know where to find me.
